name: Japan map: a newly founded city takes a name from its own house's pool

steps.code: BuildHeadlessGameSetup(); g_GameParameters:FullRefresh(); if GameConfiguration.GetRuleSet()~='RULESET_JAC_BANSEIKI' then error('wrong ruleset after refresh') end; HideGameSetup(); return 'headless setup refreshed'

condition.code: local n=0; for _,p in ipairs(PlayerManager.GetAliveMajors()) do n=n+p:GetCities():GetCount() end; return n>=56

steps.code: local base=1000; local cities={}; for _,p in ipairs(PlayerManager.GetAliveMajors()) do for _,c in p:GetCities():Members() do cities[#cities+1]={c:GetX(),c:GetY()} end end; local function free(pl,d) if pl:IsWater() or pl:IsImpassable() or pl:IsCity() or pl:IsNaturalWonder() then return false end; for _,xy in ipairs(cities) do if Map.GetPlotDistance(pl:GetX(),pl:GetY(),xy[1],xy[2])<d then return false end end; return true end; local function find(id) for _,rule in ipairs({{true,3},{true,2},{false,3}}) do for i=0,Map.GetPlotCount()-1 do local pl=Map.GetPlotByIndex(i); if (not rule[1] or pl:GetOwner()==id) and free(pl,rule[2]) then return pl end end end end; local n=0; for _,p in ipairs(PlayerManager.GetAliveMajors()) do local id=p:GetID(); local civ=PlayerConfigurations[id]:GetCivilizationTypeName(); local pool={}; for row in GameInfo.CityNames() do if row.CivilizationType==civ and row.SortIndex>=0 and row.SortIndex<base then pool[row.CityName]=true end end; local target=find(id); if not target then error('no free plot for '..civ) end; local c=p:GetCities():Create(target:GetX(),target:GetY()); if not c then error('city not created for '..civ) end; local name=c:GetName(); print('[JAC_HOUSE_CITY_NAMES] civ='..civ..' plot='..target:GetIndex()..' owner='..target:GetOwner()..' name='..tostring(name)..' text='..Locale.Lookup(name)); if not pool[name] then error(civ..' founded '..tostring(name)..', not a name from its own pool') end; cities[#cities+1]={c:GetX(),c:GetY()}; n=n+1 end; if n~=22 then error('expected 22 founded cities, got '..n) end; return 'house names: '..n
